The kinds head, t_kind, w_kind and the rule were chosen there too, on the same wildlife photos together with a third of the `train` rows of the extra set coco-kinds (people, cats, dogs, grazing animals, rooms with nothing alive). name_at, offer_at and kind_at are set by tools/eval/shipped.py through tools/fusion/fuse.py.

needs: fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`)

fitted_on.rule: Rows were fitted only on photos in the public domain (CC0, no known copyright restrictions, United States Government work) or shared under CC BY.
fitted_on.sources: train/alachua-pre2025: iNaturalist observations (open-data files); extra/coco-kinds: COCO 2017 images from Flickr. Each row of the list gives the address and the licence.
fitted_on.not_listed: Settings (prior weight, temperatures, thresholds) were chosen on the evaluation photos of the `val` split and on a third of the extra set's training rows; no row was fitted on them.

fusion_thresholds_note: set by tools/eval/shipped.py on 1803 tuning photos (val) through tools/fusion/fuse.py; 2 means never
fusion_kind_at_note: kind_at was set by tools/eval/shipped.py through tools/fusion/fuse.py: the lowest level from which an asserted kind was right at least 95 times in 100 on 1803 wildlife tuning photos and on 3056 extra-set (coco-kinds) tuning photos. Under it the page should say that it is not sure and offer its three likeliest kinds.
